_comment: Sentinel probe: the workload shell must NOT be PID 1. The agent (or init) owns PID 1 in the guest; a workload running as PID 1 would inherit init's signal semantics and indicate the exec path is wired wrong. Related to the threat model's core principle (section 3): untrusted code runs as a CHILD of the agent.

process.commandLine: if [ "$$" -ne 1 ] 2>/dev/null; then echo PID_OK; else echo PID_BUG; fi
